PROP-0000-create-pre-001.text: Authenticated users must not modify is_admin column via self-update RLS policy.
PROP-0000-create-pre-001.assertion: forall u: authenticated_update(members, u) => u.is_admin == old(u.is_admin)

locations.note: Self-update path: only updates student_number; is_admin is never touched; uses supabaseAdmin (service_role) client which bypasses RLS
Only path that sets is_admin; requires caller to be admin (checkAdmin via is_admin lookup); non-admin callers get 403-equivalent error
